item.tib: tshe dbang dz+wa this rigs lnga'i srung ba mi 'jig gur khang
item.coloph: de ltar 'phrin las srung ba'i rim pa 'di/ phyi rabs don du tshe dbang bdag gis sbyar/ 'di la gang brtson bar chod rkyen tshogs kyis/ bskyod pa mi tshug mi 'jig sku ru brnyes/ mi mthun bgegs las rnam par rgyal nges so/ bka' 'di g.yung drung gsal dang dmu tshar gtad/ bon chos dar nub skabs su gshen rnams kyi (kyis/)brda' yig bris te zhang zhung sgo ma'i phyogs/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas tshab rin chen brag tsI ta 'dra ba'i brag la gter du sbos/ dam can srung mas bya ra lhang lhang gzobs/ phyis su rten 'brel rnam pa lnga shar tshe/ stong chen rnam rol las can sprul sku yis/ zab mo gter gyi sgo mo 'byed par shog/ phyis su bdag 'dra sems dpa'i ming 'dzin gshen spral thugs rje nyi mas phug leb 'o ma stag rtse'i gnas mchog nas la sgril zhig rnyed de lo mang bka' rgya gdab/ slar smon sras mu la'i mtshan 'chang dang*/ hor sras pu Ne rta dza mchog gi bka' yi gnang ba thob pa dang*/ de mtshungs grwa ha ra tshul mi/ wer zhi shel bzhin/ drung mu khi khar jing sangs kro ta'i ming 'chang sogs nas nan bskul ngor/ gshen gyi bla brang du shog ser zhal bshus pa'o//
